text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Hassan emphasises during a meeting with the head of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference its role in reflecting the "real image of Islam".
- Prime Minister Abdul Salam al-Majali announces a public holiday on May 1 to mark Labour Day. AL-DUSTOUR
- Interior minister says changes in election law to govern the Novemeber elections will be announced next week.
- A second shipment of Iraq-bound cargo of French wheat to be shipped through Jordan under the oil-for-food deal expected to be offloaded at Aqaba port next Wednesday.
- Two brothers kill their 50-year old father in the town of Buseira.
